title: PR names itself check
goal: CI fails when a PR number appears in no record, task or log
acceptance: `core/tools/check-pr-record.mjs` reads the PR number from the CI event, searches `docs/work/`, `docs/BACKLOG.md` and `docs/archive/`, and fails when absent; it skips bot authors and runs with no PR (push to main, local run) without failing
Fixtures: PR named in a record, in a task file, in the archive; not named; bot PR; no PR environment
The CI snippets pass the event number; the procedure text is unchanged except for a pointer to the check
Failing test committed first: the "PR not named" fixture expects a failure against an empty tool; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 2 h plus six fixtures and the workflow event wiring. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
